answer: Reputation-weighted queueing. Each identity’s standing is fixed to a basalt-like record of completed micro-contracts, and new identities start at zero weight, so their jobs sit behind every established one until they finish real work. A trellis of escrowed payments links each completed job to the next bid, making identity farming cost the full escrow plus idle time per fake account. Attackers must fund and run genuine work through every shell before it earns queue position, and that carried jade of verified history cannot be bought in bulk.
